facts: AllocationPool: immutable exclusive/fungible capacity and exact unit
AllocationReservation: inert typed interval/quantity candidate and explicit hold expiry
AllocationJournal: unique pool ordinal and command identity, simultaneously guarded transition and capacity claim
operations: Create typed pool/reservation candidates through Engine
Allocations.act: reserve, allocate, release, cancel, expire via validated single-row guarded commit
Allocations.inspect: current authority projected to booking instant with observed journal head
invariants: Only validated journal interpretation grants ownership; raw candidate rows never constitute authority
Each transition atomically commits its unique pool ordinal as both guard and claim; concurrent stale ordinal loses and retries
Every validated prefix obeys exact time-overlap capacity; exclusive pool capacity is one
Release/cancel/expire are conditional terminal transitions; command keys replay without repeated release
Enumeration and every terminal/candidate read fail closed under authorization; malformed raw journals poison rather than authorize
Journal is bounded to 512 rows; no multi-pool atomicity, general read overlay or live-provider guarantee is implied

acceptance.description: fixtures for Runner/GPU, hospital bed and machine reservation
